title: Manually Jog the Tipper End Effector Using Operator Station HMI (Visu_Dual_MCP)
summary: Use the operator station HMI jogging screen (Visu_Dual_MCP) to stop the automatic tipping cycle and manually move the tipper axes (Z1/A1 for left, Z2/A2 for right) using the +/− controls in Manual Mode.
when_to_use: When you need to move the tipper end effector into a desired maintenance position by manually jogging the left and/or right tipper axes from the operator station HMI (Visu_Dual_MCP).
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Navigate the operator station HMI to Visu_Dual_MCP, stop the automatic tipping cycle, enter jogging/manual mode, and jog the selected axes using the on-screen +/− controls while avoiding hard stops.
safety_notes: Stop jogging before the axis reaches a hard stop; pushing an axis to a hard stop registers a fault.
access_or_tools_needed: HMI controls: CYCLE STOP, JOG, axis +/− buttons (Z1, Z2, A1, A2)

system_preconditions: Operator station HMI is available and you can navigate to the "Visu_Dual_MCP" screen (F3).

visual_references.description: Visu_Dual_MCP jogging screen showing Manual Mode and the Z1/Z2/A1/A2 axis +/− controls.
Operator station main screen showing the CYCLE STOP button.

steps.title: Navigate to the Visu_Dual_MCP jogging screen (F3)
steps.purpose: Open the operator station HMI screen that provides the CYCLE STOP and JOG controls for tipper jogging.
steps.instruction: On the operator station HMI, navigate to the "Visu_Dual_MCP" screen (F3).
steps.expected_result: The "Visu_Dual_MCP" screen is displayed and you can access the CYCLE STOP and JOG controls.
steps.healthy_condition: You are on the "Visu_Dual_MCP" screen (F3) with the tipper operator controls visible.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot find the "Visu_Dual_MCP" screen (F3) or the CYCLE STOP/JOG controls are not available.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: On the operator station HMI, navigate to "Visu_Dual_MCP" (F3).

steps.title: Stop the automatic tipping cycle using CYCLE STOP
steps.purpose: Ensure the tipper is not running the automatic tipping cycle before entering manual jogging.
steps.instruction: Press "CYCLE STOP" to stop the automatic tipping cycle.
steps.expected_result: The automatic tipping cycle is stopped (CYCLE STOP action has been applied).
steps.healthy_condition: The operator station is in a state where you can proceed to press JOG to open the jogging screen.
steps.failure_condition: The automatic tipping cycle does not stop (you cannot proceed to jogging as expected).

actions.label: Press CYCLE STOP
actions.exact_action: Press CYCLE STOP to stop the automatic tipping cycle.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Press CYCLE STOP to stop the automatic tipping cycle.
Press CYCLE STOP on the operator station main screen.

steps.title: Open the jogging screen using JOG
steps.purpose: Enter the manual jogging interface where axis +/− controls are available.
steps.instruction: Press "JOG" to open the jogging screen.
steps.expected_result: The jogging screen opens and shows Manual Mode.
steps.healthy_condition: Manual Mode is indicated on the jogging screen.
steps.failure_condition: The jogging screen does not open or Manual Mode is not indicated.

actions.label: Press JOG
actions.exact_action: Press JOG to open the jogging screen.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Press JOG to open the jogging screen. ... + – Manual Mode

steps.title: Confirm Manual Mode and identify axis controls (Z1, Z2, A1, A2)
steps.purpose: Ensure you are in the correct mode and you select the correct axis controls for the left vs right tipper.
steps.instruction: On the jogging screen, confirm you are in "Manual Mode" and identify the axis controls for Z1, Z2, A1, and A2.
steps.expected_result: Manual Mode is shown and the axis +/− controls for Z1, Z2, A1, and A2 are visible.
steps.healthy_condition: You can clearly see the Z1 Axis, Z2 Axis, A1 Axis, and A2 Axis sections with +/− buttons.
steps.failure_condition: Manual Mode is not indicated or one/both axis control groups are not visible.

actions.label: Verify Manual Mode and axis controls
actions.exact_action: Confirm you are in "Manual Mode" and identify the axis controls for Z1, Z2, A1, and A2.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Z1 Axis ... Z2 Axis ... A2 Axis ... A1 Axis ... + – Manual Mode

steps.title: Jog the left tipper axes (Z1/A1) or right tipper axes (Z2/A2) using +/−
steps.purpose: Move the tipper end effector into the desired maintenance position by jogging the correct axes.
steps.instruction: Select the axis you want to move and use the "−" and "+" buttons to move it: Z1 (vertical movement) and A1 (rotate gripper) move the left tipper; Z2 and A2 move the right tipper.
steps.expected_result: The selected axis responds to the jog command while Manual Mode is active.
steps.healthy_condition: Jogging causes the intended axis motion for the selected tipper (left via Z1/A1, right via Z2/A2).
steps.failure_condition: The axis does not respond to jog commands or the wrong tipper side moves relative to the axis selection.

actions.label: Select axis and jog with +/−
actions.exact_action: Select the axis you want to move and use the − and + buttons to move the axis.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The Z1 AXIS (vertical movement) and A1 AXIS (rotate the gripper) buttons move the left tipper; the Z2 AXIS and A2 AXIS buttons move the right tipper.

steps.title: Use correct +/− motion behavior for Z and A axes
steps.purpose: Ensure the axis moves in the intended direction to reach the maintenance position safely.
steps.instruction: Use the +/− behavior as documented: "+" moves the Z-axis up and rotates the A-axis toward the operator; "−" moves the Z-axis down and rotates the A-axis away from the operator.
steps.expected_result: Pressing "+" produces Z up + A toward operator motion; pressing "−" produces Z down + A away motion.
steps.healthy_condition: Axis motion direction matches the documented +/− behavior.
steps.failure_condition: Axis motion direction is opposite of the documented behavior or does not match the selected axis.

actions.label: Jog with correct +/− direction
actions.exact_action: The + button moves the Z-axis up and rotates the A-axis towards the operator. The − button moves the Z-axis down and rotates the A-axis away from the operator.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: a. The + button moves the Z-axis up and rotates the A-axis towards the operator. b. The − button moves the Z-axis down and rotates the A-axis away from the operator.

steps.title: Avoid hard stops; stop jogging before the axis reaches a hard stop
steps.purpose: Prevent the axis from registering a fault due to contact with a hard stop.
steps.instruction: Stop jogging before the axis reaches a hard stop. Do not push the axis into the hard stop.
steps.expected_result: No hard-stop fault is registered while jogging.
steps.healthy_condition: You can position the end effector without triggering a fault indication.
steps.failure_condition: The axis registers a fault after being pushed to a hard stop.

actions.label: Monitor for hard-stop fault indication
actions.exact_action: If you push the axis until it hits a hard stop, the axis will register a fault.

stop_or_escalate_if: If an axis is driven into a hard stop and the axis registers a fault, stop further jogging and escalate to maintenance/support for the fault condition.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: If you push the axis until it hits a hard stop, the axis will register a fault.

success_criteria: Tipper end effector responds to selected axis jog commands while HMI is in Manual Mode.
Operator avoids driving an axis into a hard stop (no hard-stop fault registered).
healthy_conditions: Manual Mode is indicated on the Visu_Dual_MCP jogging screen.
Z1/A1 controls move the left tipper and Z2/A2 controls move the right tipper.
+ moves Z up and A toward the operator; − moves Z down and A away from the operator.
No hard-stop fault indication occurs during jogging.
failure_conditions: Axis registers a fault after being pushed to a hard stop.
escalation_guidance: If an axis is driven into a hard stop and the axis registers a fault, stop further jogging and escalate to maintenance/support for the fault condition.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: Navigate to "Visu_Dual_MCP" (F3), press CYCLE STOP, press JOG, then use Z1/A1 for left and Z2/A2 for right with +/−; + moves Z up and A toward operator, − moves Z down and A away; pushing to a hard stop registers a fault.
Press CYCLE STOP on the operator station main screen.
